'''Riot clone troopers''' were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] and were utilized during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for [[riot]] control and other [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] actions.

==History==
[[File:RiotCloneTroopers-DoM.png|thumb|left|200px|Riot troopers while searching for Duchess Satine]]
The riot troopers were units of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] that were given special training in controlling crowds with the use of nonlethal weapons. Riot trooper [[Squad/Legends|squads]] were always ready for deployment, stationed in [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] spread across the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. They also assisted the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] when needed, supplying backup or helping in the hunt for dangerous fugitives.

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the Clone Wars, some riot troopers were deployed in the search for [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] after she was falsely believed to have killed [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]].

The riot clone trooper units were armed with [[Riot shield/Legends|riot shields]] and [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]].

==Behind the scenes==
The riot clone troopers bear the color markings of the Coruscant Guard, identifying them as affiliated with the Guard.
